text: いい　どきょうじゃ　ねーか　まけたら　こづかい　よこせよ！

structure.jp: いい　どきょうじゃ　ねーか
structure.en: you've got some nerve, don't you

structure.jp: こづかい　よこせよ！

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.span: どきょうじゃ　ねーか
patterns.explanation: じゃないか at the end means 'isn't it so!' and pushes the listener to agree; ねー is the rough form of ない. いい どきょうじゃ ねーか = 'that's some nerve you've got, isn't it'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. まけたら = 'if you lose'.

patterns.name: 〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending (ろ on some verbs, an え-sound on others) is a blunt order. よこす becomes よこせ = 'hand it over!'.
